Tesselate

Tesselate is an open-source toolkit for inspecting, repairing and simplifying polygon meshes. It is a command-line tool and a small browser inspector, built for people who work with scanned geometry and need to find out why a mesh will not print, render or simulate.

It is free, there is nothing to buy, and there is no account to create. If you want to try it, get started with the installation guide or open the inspector in your browser.

What it does

  • Reports non-manifold edges, flipped normals and self-intersections.
  • Simplifies a mesh to a target triangle count while preserving boundaries.
  • Exports to OBJ, PLY, STL and glTF without re-triangulating.
